title: Huang's exit tests Nvidia's annual chip cadence and Taiwan suppliers' customer mix
html:
Nvidia's decision not to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive has raised concerns about a potential slowdown in AI hardware upgrades, putting Taiwanese suppliers' capacity allocation and order mix across major customers under scrutiny.

Credit: DIGITIMES
